subject: Acme Telecom: KMS BYOK handshake & HSM attestation - evidence handoff
messages:
From: Diane Park <diane.park@acmetel.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmetel.com
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: BYOK handshake logs + HSM attestation for SIG review

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our SIG assessment (crypto controls section) we need two items to close out the KMS thread: a machine-readable export of the BYOK handshake transactions for Nov–Dec 2026 and a copy of the latest HSM attestation signed by your vendor.

Specific asks:
- BYOK handshake export (include timestamps, public key IDs, requester service, and status). CSV or log is fine.
- HSM attestation (PDF) including firmware/serial numbers and attestation date.
- Key rotation summary for Q4 2026 (policy + rotation log) — a short CSV is sufficient.

Would you be able to provide redacted artifacts by EOD Wednesday PST? We can open a secure transfer (SFTP) or accept a signed Drive link. If anything needs an NDA or redaction, flag it.

Regards,
Diane Park
Security Architect, Acme Telecom
Diane.Park@acmetel.com

--
Attachment: request-template-sig.xlsx (referenced)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Diane Park <diane.park@acmetel.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-13T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: BYOK handshake logs + HSM attestation for SIG review

Diane —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the artifacts and I want to outline what we'll include and our handoff plan:

1) redwood_byok_handshake.log (attached) — sanitized to remove any raw private key material. Fields: timestamp, requester_service, key_id (SHA256 thumbprint), operation (import|activate|deactivate), status.

2) hsm_attestation_statement_signed.pdf (attached) — vendor-signed attestation including model/serial and attestation timestamp (2026-11-30). Note: vendor redacts internal telemetry per their policy; statement includes firmware version X.Y.Z.

3) kms_key_rotation_report_2026Q4.csv (attached) — rotation events for customer-visible keys (rotation_timestamp, key_id, rotated_by_role, verification_hash).

Delivery options: we uploaded the attachments to a scoped Drive folder and issued a DocuSign envelope for the attestation copy. Link and envelope id below. If you prefer SFTP, we can push there instead.

I'll loop Rishi for the export format questions and Lauren to confirm signatures and DocuSign routing. If you need any additional cryptographic proof (e.g., import-event KMS audit records), say the word and we can scope it.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_byok_handshake.log, hsm_attestation_statement_signed.pdf, kms_key_rotation_report_2026Q4.csv

Related links:
https://drive.redwood/test/accounts/acme-telecom/kms-evidence
DocuSign envelope: ENVELOPE-0a9b2c3d4e

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-14T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: BYOK handshake logs + HSM attestation for SIG review

Kim — quick notes on the artifacts before we ship to Acme:

- BYOK log: I inspected the export; we should add an extra column 'redaction_version' to indicate what fields were redacted and why (vendor policy vs. PII). That speeds reviewers.
- Attestation: vendor signature is SHA256 with a timestamp. Recommend including a short verification instruction in the Drive readme (how to validate signature).
- Rotation CSV: add a header row with the policy reference (Policy ID: KMS-ROT-2024-v2).

I updated the Drive readme and added the verification snippet. Also confirmed that the attestation PDF has a visible signature time (2026-11-30T15:40:12Z).

If Acme asks for raw HSM serial audit logs, we should route that request to Legal for a data-sharing exception; those logs contain vendor-internal IDs.

Rishi
Principal Applied ML Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Diane Park <diane.park@acmetel.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmetel.com, KeySafe Audit Team <audit@keysafe.io>
Date: 2026-12-15T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: BYOK handshake logs + HSM attestation for SIG review

Kim, Rishi —

Received the files and readme; verified the attestation signature per your snippet. The artifacts are sufficient for the SIG review team to mark the crypto controls as addressed. A couple of small follow-ups:

- Can you confirm the retention window for BYOK handshake logs (we need evidence of 12-month retention policy)?
- Please provide the rotation policy excerpt (KMS-ROT-2024-v2) as a short PDF we can attach to the questionnaire.

Procurement will also touch base about a standard BAA amendment for BYOK custody language. I'll send the procurement contact separately.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this clears a major compliance blocker for our production rollout.

Best,
Diane
Security Architect, Acme Telecom

--
Forwarded-for-record: KeySafe Audit Team <audit@keysafe.io> (they confirmed no further signature questions)
